Culture refers to the shared way of life that defines a group of
people, and is often passed down through generations, shaping
how people in a society see the world, interact with each other,
and conduct their daily lives. Thus, culture includes values,
morals, customs, and traditions, as well as art, music, literature,
philosophy, and science.
